decisions.decision: Keep the current v3 aesthetic (Pumpkin Amber palette + current fonts); rebuild STRUCTURE only
decisions.rationale: Monty rejected the flame palette + Fraunces/Space Grotesk mock; the real problem was the broken blob + incoherent structure, not the colors

decisions.decision: Homepage becomes a who->what->engage personal-brand narrative; remove the WebGL blob from the home path
decisions.rationale: The blob read as a tech demo that did not answer 'who is this person'; Monty wants a business-like page

decisions.decision: Velvet-rope engagement: no CTA button, no contact page; woven contextual invitations; getting in touch is deliberately not easy
decisions.rationale: Monty wants visitors to feel 'this person is very cool, how do I reach them'

decisions.decision: Hybrid writing model: Monty Monthly newsletter is the headline + subscribe action; a few flagship essays shown open; merge /writing + /newsletter into one surface
decisions.rationale: Essays live inside the newsletter; the light gate doubles as the velvet rope

decisions.decision: Cut /events + /photos; delete /specimen + /v3-specimen; fold /links into footer; fold /watching into a reframed /uses ('Things I love'); keep /about + /prometheus dedicated
decisions.rationale: Tighten IA to the new scope
